one.q: Do you guarantee cure in Rohani Ilaj?
one.a: No. We offer ruqyah and guidance with sincerity. Healing is with Allah's will, and results differ for each person.

two.q: Can I come only for homeopathic treatment?
two.a: Yes. Book a homeo consultation and we will focus on your health history and symptoms.

three.q: Are herbal products safe to use with other medicine?
three.a: Tell us what you already take. We will advise if something should be avoided or spaced apart.

four.a: We do not share your details. Sensitive cases are discussed in a separate, quiet space when possible.

five.q: How do I apply for free school support?
five.a: Contact us with basic family information. Our team reviews cases as seats and funds allow.

six.q: What should I bring to the first visit?
six.a: Your ID, any previous reports, and a list of medicines you use. For Rohani cases, come with wudu if you can.
